== Summary ==
Partial slip “•Don’t Do That Again (Reflections III)” cut unchanged from page 2 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF file created 2 August 2024), rendered at 300 dpi. Recorded with version [[Don't Do That Again (Reflections III) (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): cut from that card image, with the same words; a slip that reprints a card image is recorded with that version, not as a separate version. Not a recreation.
